verdict.rationale: Steel is a browser API for agents, so an official MCP server is a fair question. First-party docs show its Claude Agent SDK integration exposing a Steel cloud browser as in-process MCP tools, and a cookbook entry titled "Expose a Steel browser to any MCP client." However, the cookbook framing reads more like a recipe than a packaged, standalone official MCP server. Missing for 10: a documented standalone or hosted official MCP server (package name or endpoint), setup and tool-list documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
